Game Overview

In Pomme Pomme, the core idea is straightforward: keep your fruit bouncing adventure alive in Pomme Pomme. Skillfully maneuver your trampoline to keep fruit airborne and collect stars while dodging falling bombs. Quick reflexes and strategic moves enhance your score for endless fun.
